title: Contract Project Manager
description:
We are recruiting for a Contract Project Manager for a contract to start ASAP.
Who We Are:
AND Digital are a tech company focused on accelerating digital delivery and dedicated to closing the digital skills gap. We’ve been helping organisations build better digital products and stronger digital teams since 2014.
We believe our work should always make a remarkable impact for our clients. We do this through our regional offices (or ‘Clubs’) building strong relationships with our partners, so that they are always prioritised by a team within close proximity.
This unique model has driven success for our clients and ourselves, evidenced by our remarkable organic growth since 2014. Today we number more than 1,300 people with Clubs all over the UK, Europe and the USA with plans for global expansion in the next couple of years.
Join us - and help us fulfil our mission to close the world’s digital skills gap.
Role Overview:
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Junior Project Manager to join our team. In this role, you will work in close partnership with and directly support a Senior Project Manager, gaining invaluable hands-on experience across the entire project lifecycle. This is an exceptional opportunity for an aspiring project professional to develop their skills, manage key administrative and coordination tasks, and learn best-in-class project management methodologies from seasoned leaders.
Key Responsibilities:

• Senior PM Support: Work hand-in-hand with the Senior PM to oversee daily operations, assist with resource allocation, and help maintain project documentation, plans, and budgets.

• Coordinating Deliverables: Actively track team tasks, coordinate the timely delivery of project milestones, and ensure cross-functional team members are aligned with deadlines.

• Escalating Blockers: Proactively identify project risks, issues, or delays, and swiftly escalate blockers to the Senior PM to ensure rapid resolution and minimal impact on timelines.

• Reporting on Progress: Consistently gather status updates, maintain project dashboards, and draft clear progress reports for internal teams and stakeholders.

• Meeting Facilitation: Organise project meetings, prepare agendas, and document action items to ensure momentum is maintained after every sync.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Strong Organisational Skills: Exceptional ability to multitask, prioritise, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.

• Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to confidently interface with diverse team members.

• Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive attitude with a knack for spotting potential issues before they become critical blockers.

• Tools: Familiarity with project management software (e.g., Azure DevOps / Jira / Asana) and productivity suites (e.g., MS Office) is a strong plus.

Equal Opportunities Statement
We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. We actively encourage applications from women, ethnic minorities, and individuals with disabilities. We consider all flexible working arrangements, subject to the requirements of the role. Where reasonable adjustments are needed, we will strive to make changes to accommodate them.
AI Statement
We champion tech that helps people work smarter, but we want to get to know you! If you use AI to assist with your application or interview prep, please ensure all information submitted remains an accurate, truthful representation of your personal achievements and capabilities rather than generating false or misleading information. We may reject applications where AI is used inappropriately at any stage of the recruitment process.

description:

Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers - including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce - trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Spain and Ireland only. 

The Opportunity: 

About our Platform:
Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves them to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and, of course, do it efficiently and effectively.

The Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) delivered by the Foundations group provides application engineers with the tools, systems and Kubernetes clusters they need to build, deploy and run their workloads. 

We are hiring an engineer as part of the creation of a new Foundation’s “Metal” squad. This squad will be responsible for building and provisioning resources including storage, networking and Kubernetes clusters in new environments, starting with our own physical hardware. They will provide a Kubernetes control plane and underlying resources, outside public Cloud, to the rest of Engineering.

What Makes You a Great Fit:
You enjoy working with engineers, as well as with the management structures that are there to support you and enable you and your team to do your very best. 

You are comfortable working in a remote-first company ; communication is key. For us, working together means being collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful. We operate by consensus, you can contribute to a discussion but then commit to the team decision.

As such, being such a highly distributed company, means we would love someone who is keen on working with  distributed systems , too.

You are eager to  learn and grow . There is a lot of room for growth and development, and the team has quite a lot of knowledge to share for those who are wanting to learn. 

You approach development  holistically . The team owns the full life cycle of our code; from writing design docs, to looking at developer feedback, and integration testing. We appreciate engineers who enjoy looking at the big picture, and also notice the details of the brush strokes. The Platform team mainly works with Go, Python, and Shell.

You have experience with  operating your code . Since a lot of operators and developers use our software, having some grounding in both of these spaces really helps us with building better platforms for our users.

As a Life Underwriting Specialist, you'll analyze, select and classify applications for life insurance of a moderately complex nature according to established underwriting policies, practices and standards. You'll coordinate life insurance selection standards according to underwriting practices and procedures to achieve satisfactory mortality and morbidity experience and acceptable administrative results. Key Responsibilities:

• Receives, evaluates and underwrites, on a medical or non-medical basis, mild to moderately complex applications for life insurance up to their maximum handling limit as approved by the Chief Underwriter. Protects the confidentiality of documentation and information acquired throughout the underwriting process. Operates with autonomy but still uses referral points - mentors, staff underwriters and medical staff - as needed.

• Maintains in-depth knowledge of manuals, underwriting materials, rules, regulations, procedures medical factors and practices impacting mortality and morbidity underwriting. Maintains proven understanding of all underwriting administrative systems to conduct business and provides outstanding service to all internal and external customers and field partners.

title: Principal Detection Engineer (Remote, GBR)
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed - we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:
CrowdStrike stops breaches. This role ensures we stop them everywhere, not just in one corner of the platform.
Today, our detection teams operate across endpoint, cloud, NG-SIEM, identity, and SaaS security. They're individually strong. But threat actors don't respect domain boundaries, a supply chain attack lands on macOS, pivots through cloud credentials, and exfiltrates via a compromised SaaS app. We need someone who sees the full picture and turns it into detection coverage that outlasts any single campaign.
This function will report directly to the Sr Director of Engineering of the Detection Content Platform Group. This is a high visible, high impact role that will help us solve one of the hardest problems in cybersecurity: making an entire platform detect threats coherently, across every surface, at the speed adversaries operate. Threat actors are AI-force-multiplied, they stand up campaigns in hours and generate permutations on the fly. We need to detect and respond at the same scale and velocity..
What You’ll Do:

• Own cross-domain detection strategy. Maintain visibility into the detection team's work, endpoint (Windows, macOS, Linux), cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes), NG-SIEM, identity (IDP), SaaS security (Adaptive Shield), and FEM. Identify where the same attack scenario has coverage on one surface but gaps on another, and work with the teams to close those gaps systematically.

• Design high-fidelity correlation detections. Build detection logic that joins signals across domains, entity resolution, temporal reasoning, behavioral layering. Deliver high-severity, low-FP detections via Platform IOAs (CDE) that resist bypass and remain effective over time.

• Drive threat-informed prioritization. Monitor internal and external intel sources. Partner with OverWatch, Falcon Complete, product managers across all modules, and customer success teams. Translate threat landscape shifts into concrete detection investment decisions. Top threat scenarios get deep, multi-domain coverage before they hit customer environments.

• Coordinate cross-team detection development. When a researcher writes a detection for a scenario on one platform, ensure coverage ships across all relevant surfaces simultaneously. No detection ships in isolation when the scenario spans domains.

• Apply AI/LLM to detection workflows. Identify opportunities to use automation and large language models to accelerate gap analysis, triage threat intel, and prototype correlation logic. Drive adoption of AI-assisted workflows across the detection engineering function.

• Coach and enable detection engineers across teams. Set technical direction. PR reviews, hands-on technical coach

•

CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code for containerized deployments, including Helm and GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or Flux

Production troubleshooting experience across Node.js and JVM/Java services, with strong depth in at least one runtime environment. • Distributed tracing and request-context correlation

Your Impact at LILA

We are seeking a computational materials scientist to discover and optimize materials for electro-optic and photonic technologies. The role centers on understanding how composition, structure, defects, processing conditions, and operating environments influence optical and electro-optic behavior-and translating those insights into experimentally testable materials hypotheses.

You will develop first-principles and multiscale simulation workflows spanning electronic-structure calculations, lattice dynamics, atomistic modeling, and connections to electromagnetic or device-level models. These workflows will predict properties such as electronic structure, dielectric and optical response, polarization, phonons, and electro-optic coefficients. You will also integrate these capabilities into automated, agentic discovery systems that can plan studies, select and invoke tools, evaluate results, recover from failures, and iteratively refine computational hypotheses.

This is a hands-on scientific role at the intersection of condensed-matter physics, materials chemistry, photonics, and AI-enabled discovery. You will collaborate with experimental scientists, ML researchers, and software engineers to build validated workflows, establish structure-property-performance relationships, and prioritize candidates for experimental evaluation.

What You'll Be Building

• Lead computational discovery efforts for materials relevant to electro-optic and integrated photonic applications.

• Develop and validate first-principles, atomistic, and multiscale workflows-including DFT and response-property calculations-to predict electronic, vibrational, dielectric, optical, and electro-optic behavior.

• Interpret material response across composition, structure, defects, interfaces, strain, and temperature; assess stability, synthesizability, and performance tradeoffs to prioritize candidates.

• Connect intrinsic material properties to device requirements such as optical loss, modulation efficiency, operating wavelength, and fabrication compatibility.

• Compare predictions with experimental measurements, investigate discrepancies, and build effective computational-experimental feedback loops.

• Build reproducible, automated workflows for high-throughput simulation, data provenance, validation, convergence testing, and uncertainty assessment.

• Develop agentic frameworks that orchestrate simulation codes, scientific databases, analysis tools, and surrogate models; partner with ML and software teams on planning, validation, failure recovery, and human review.

• Analyze simulation and experimental data to generate actionable materials hypotheses and communicate recommendations, assumptions, and limitations.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• PhD or equivalent experience in Physics, Materials Science, Chemistry, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Strong background in computational condensed-matter physics, materials science, physical chemistry, or a related discipline, with experience studying functional optical, dielectric, or electronic materials.

• Expertise in electronic-structure methods and calculating and interpreting dielectric, optical, vibrational, polarization, or related response properties using perturbative, finite-field, Berry-phase, or comparable methods.

• Working knowledge of crystallographic symmetry, electronic structure, lattice dynamics, light-matter interaction, and structure-property relationships.

• Experience with established electronic-structure packages and reproducible HPC or cloud workflows, including scheduling, data management, and automated analysis; strong Python and scientific software skills.

• Familiarity with agentic AI, tool-calling, or workflow orchestration and the design of reliable, auditable workflows across scientific tools.

Bonus Points For

• Experience with materials or device concepts relevant to electro-optics and integrated photonics, including ferroelectrics, semiconduc

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform-where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.

Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. FICO (NYSE: FICO ) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
The Opportunity
As Sr. Manager of Global Travel & Corporate Card Services, you'll drive innovation and operational excellence across a 30-country program, partnering closely with senior leadership to keep FICO 's travel and card services sophisticated, scalable, and competitive. This is a unique opportunity to blend supplier strategy, technology evaluation, and cross-functional relationship-building into a role that directly shapes the employee experience worldwide.
What You’ll Contribute

• Execute global travel and card strategy aligned with FICO 's business priorities, establishing and continuously refining KPIs to measure program effectiveness, cost efficiency, and traveler satisfaction, while evolving the framework to drive innovation, scalability, and operational excellence.

• Measure and enhance the end-to-end travel experience, identifying and resolving pain points, and develop effective communications to influence traveler behavior and drive program adoption.

• Oversee global Travel Management Company (TMC) and Corporate Card operations, managing preferred supplier relationships and leading sourcing, negotiations, contracting, and ongoing performance management to ensure optimal service delivery.

• Evolve global travel and card policies to reflect business priorities, market conditions, and compliance requirements, and drive policy adherence through education, communication, and system optimization.

• Identify, develop, and deliver cost savings initiatives and value capture opportunities, analyzing spend data to inform strategic decisions, build business cases, and present insights to senior leadership.

• Optimize travel booking tools and card platforms to improve usability, compliance, and reporting.

• Ensure robust travel risk management protocols and duty-of-care practices are in place, partnering with Security, HR, and Risk teams to support traveler safety and crisis response.

• Build strong partnerships across Procurement, Finance, AP, Internal Audit, HR, Legal, Marketing, Physical Security, Risk, and Executive Administration, with a proven ability to partner closely with C-Suite and executive teams.

• Challenge the status quo by identifying opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement, staying informed on industry trends through external networks, events, and partnerships.

What We’re Seeking

• Bachelor’s degree in related field is strongly preferred.

• Experience working in corporate travel with strong preference for managing a company travel program.

• Understanding of travel booking tool functionality, capabilities and site messaging.

• Understanding of corporate card programs and related technologies.

• Demonstrated contract sourcing and agreement experience for travel and card services and suppliers.

• Experience working and partnering within diverse global cultures and regions to drive local programs and processes within a global framework.

• Customer Service and Team Building: Has a customer focused mindset; gains support and trust from all levels of the organization, with minimal supervision.

• Deep understanding of critical travel KPI’s and associated metrics with the ability to report out to all levels up to and including C-suite.

• Experience challenging the status quo by developing business cases for change through business acumen, market intelligence and insights to drive strategic impact across the organization.

• Communicates effectively and frequently, listens carefully, and actively seeks and values the perspectives of others.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams) and other related AI tools.

• Ability and willingness to travel occasionally.

Our Offer to You

title: Product Manager
description:

Remedy Product Studio is a rapidly scaling technology company specializing in working with and investing in prominent start-ups and brands in building and scaling their digital products. We use data-driven agile approaches coupled with high performing teams as a cornerstone of our technology-first culture.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Customer First Team

We are a team of Identity and Access Management experts. We help customers, businesses, and organisations maximise their Okta IAM platform investment, providing rapid time-to-value in adoption and usage and promoting scalability and agility. Our team sits within the Customer First area - focused on ensuring the long term success of our customers.  Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

Role Summary

The Business Analyst (BA) is an essential member of the Okta Professional Services team. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn Identity and Access Management (IAM) fundamentals from the ground up. You will serve as a bridge between customer business objectives and technical implementation, developing the skills to own the requirements lifecycle and ensuring final deliveries are secure, scalable, and aligned with strategic needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Discovery & Requirements Facilitation: Facilitate stakeholder workshops to uncover requirements, map current-state IAM processes, and identify dependencies and pain points across IT, security, and application teams.

• Documentation & Solution Design: Translate business needs into detailed functional and non-functional requirements. Produce clear business process flows and solution design diagrams to visualize the "how" and "why" behind the technical configuration.

• Traceability & Solution Integrity: Support senior team members in maintaining the requirements traceability matrix to ensure alignment between business goals and technical outcomes.

• Lifecycle Partnership: Partner with technical architects and consultants to translate requirements into actionable technical specifications. Provide functional oversight during the build phase to clarify business needs, resolve variances, and advise QA on defining robust acceptance criteria.

• Transition & Hand-off: Partner with project leadership to execute change management plans, create user training documentation, and assist with go-live support during the hypercare period. Upon completion of the hypercare phase, facilitate a structured hand-off to the customer and account team for final project wrap-up and long-term support.

 

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• Experience: 3+ years in consulting, analysis and enterprise project /program delivery 

• Domain Expertise: Demonstrated willingness and aptitude to learn IAM concepts, principles, and best practices.

• Analytical Rigor: Proven ability to evaluate system feasibility and provide data-backed recommendations on security posture, identity lifecycle efficiency, and long-term scalability.

• Communication Mastery: Excellent ability to synthesize complex technical specifications for non-technical stakeholders and influence diverse groups to achieve consensus.

• Organizational Discipline: Meticulous attention to detail and the ability to balance competing functional priorities across multiple client projects in a fast-paced environment.

• Documentation Standards: Proficiency in utilizing standard project documentation templates (e.g., BRD, solution design) to ensure consistency and compliance with team practices.

• A passion for technology and eager to develop specialized skills in Identity and Access Management.

• Education: A bachelor’s degree in IT, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related fields.

Extra Credit

• Proficiency in Okta's WIC/CIC and Auth0

title: Sr. Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer
Location: Remote - Mainland USA
Department: Product Design
Reports to: Director, Product Design
Visa Sponsorship : Visa Sponsorship is not offered for this position.
Why Join Omnicell ?
At Omnicell , we’re transforming medication management by building a unified, cloud‑based platform that connects automated dispensing cabinets, mobile workflows, and AI‑powered intelligence into a single, cohesive ecosystem. Our work directly impacts clinicians, pharmacists, and patients-helping healthcare teams work safer, faster, and smarter every day.
As a Senior Product Designer , you’ll design beyond screens. You’ll shape end‑to‑end journeys across cloud, mobile, and device experiences, partner deeply with product and engineering, and use AI‑assisted tools to move from insight to working prototype faster than traditional design processes allow. If you’re excited to replace static specs with interactive, testable solutions-and bring consumer‑grade usability to healthcare-this role was built for you.
What You’ll Do
Purpose: Own the full design arc-from discovery through validated, code‑backed prototypes-delivering outcomes that improve clinical workflows, product adoption, and business performance.
As a Senior Product Designer , you will:
Design, Drafting & Prototyping

• Lead end‑to‑end journey design, accounting for system states, edge cases, error handling, and recovery paths-not just happy‑path screens.

• Deliver interactive, high‑fidelity prototypes (using tools such as Figma Make, vibe‑coding environments, or equivalent) as the primary design artifact; static specifications are the exception.

• Translate patterns and interactions from adjacent industries (fintech, retail, consumer tech) into healthcare‑appropriate solutions that meet regulatory and clinical constraints.

• Contribute to and evolve Omnicell ’s design system, including tokens, components, and usage guidelines across cloud, mobile, and device surfaces.

AI Integration & Innovation

• Use AI daily as a design partner-for ideation, layout exploration, content generation, research synthesis, and code‑assisted prototyping.

• Apply clear quality criteria to evaluate AI outputs, refining or rejecting suggestions based on user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.

• Explore and prototype AI‑enabled experiences such as adaptive interfaces, intelligent workflows, and data‑driven recommendations.

Collaboration & Influence

• Facilitate cross‑functional design sprints and workshops with Product Management, Engineering, and clinical subject‑matter experts.

• Operate within durable product triads (Designer + PM + Engineering Lead), focused on shipping outcomes-not handoffs.

• Influence decisions beyond your immediate team by clearly articulating trade‑offs, presenting rationale, and building alignment across stakeholders.

Customer Value & Discovery

• Lead discovery and validation efforts through journey mapping, ethnographic research, and user interviews with pharmacists, clinicians, and operations teams.

• Apply methods from service design, behavioral science, and operations research to deeply understand complex pharmacy and medication workflows.

Business Acumen

• Tie design decisions to measurable outcomes such as adoption, task‑time reduction, NPS, and operational efficiency.

• Monitor competitive and market trends to inform differentiation and platform‑level design strategy.

Mentorship & Craft Evolution

• Coach peers through regular feedback, documented best practices, and shared craft playbooks that scale team impact.

• Challenge assumptions, lead retrospectives, and drive process improvements when evidence calls for change.

Who You Are
Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of product design experience delivering complex, multi‑workflow systems in healthcare, enterprise SaaS, or similarly regulated domains.

• A portfolio that emphasizes interactive prototypes , demonstrating end‑to‑end journeys, systems thinking, and measurable u

title: Field Sales Executive, New Verticals Commuter Dublin
description:
FIELD SALES EXECUTIVE, NEW VERTICALS - COMMUTER DUBLIN

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace-shaping how we serve grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand-this is the team for you.

 

We’re looking for a Field Sales Executive, Commuter Dublin to join our Dublin team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us build relationships with new retail grocery partners across the region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.

 

Get to know our Commercial https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/the-commercial-team/ team - what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You’ll be joining the Regional UK and Ireland team. The Regional UK and Ireland team drives Deliveroo's performance across local markets, focusing on signing the best grocery retail selection and expanding our footprint within the region.

 

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Drive regional grocery retail acquisition: Map, prospect, pitch, and close high-value grocery retail partners across the Commuter Dublin region to expand our local market selection.

- Execute strategic business development: Engage with independent retail grocery partners via physical visits, emails, calls, and social platforms to demonstrate the commercial value of Deliveroo’s technology.

- Own the commercial onboarding journey: Oversee the end-to-end partner onboarding process to ensure it is fast, efficient, and seamless for new partners.

- Secure early partner success: Actively support and monitor new retail grocery performance within their first eight weeks on the platform to maximise their long-term growth.

- Act as a local territory expert: Build deep insight into the regional food scene, travelling across Kildare, Portlaoise, Drogheda, and surrounding areas to identify key brands that local customers crave.

 

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO THRIVE

ESSENTIAL

- Proven new business acquisition: Demonstrated sales experience with a track record of actively targeting new business, hunting out hidden gems, and delivering against demanding targets.

- Commercial negotiation skills: Strong commercial acumen with the ability to handle negotiations, understand marketplace economics, and structure profitable, sustainable deals.

- Effective communication: Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills across face-to-face, telephone, and written channels.

- Autonomy and field-based resilience: A self-motivated, tenacious approach with the ability to work independently and spend significant time out on the road meeting prospects.

- Mobility requirement: Possession of a valid driving licence and access to a personal vehicle to facilitate travel across the region.

 

NICE TO HAVE

- Industry sector knowledge: Deep interest in hospitality and food delivery, with the ability to demonstrate product and industry insights to prospective clients.

 

WHY JOIN US?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

 

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

 

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

 

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

title: Customer Success Manager

Led by a team of established contact center experts, Laivly addresses the unique needs and challenges of customer service programs, with an emphasis on ethics in AI and the customer service agent experience.

This role is remote and open to all Canadian residents.

title: QA DB Integration Testing QA
description:
This is a remote position.
Job Summary
We are seeking a QA DB Integration Engineer to validate and test data integrations, APIs, database processes, and enterprise application interfaces. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring data accuracy, integration reliability, and end-to-end quality across interconnected business systems.
This role requires strong database testing skills, API validation experience, SQL expertise, and the ability to troubleshoot complex integration workflows.
Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and execute test cases for database and integration testing.

• Validate data flow between enterprise applications, databases, APIs, and third-party systems.

• Perform backend testing using SQL queries and database validation techniques.

• Verify data transformations, mappings, and reconciliation between source and target systems.

• Test REST/SOAP APIs and integration services.

• Analyze and troubleshoot data discrepancies, integration failures, and system defects.

• Participate in system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing activities.

• Create test plans, test scenarios, test scripts, and defect reports.

• Work closely with developers, integration engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders.

• Support release validation and post-deployment testing activities.

• Ensure compliance with quality standards and testing best practices.

Required Skills

• 3+ years of experience in QA, Database Testing, or Integration Testing.

• Strong SQL skills with experience writing complex queries, joins, and data validation scripts.

• Experience testing APIs using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or similar.

• Good understanding of ETL, data mapping, and system integrations.

• Experience validating large datasets and performing data reconciliation.

• Knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with enterprise integrations, middleware, or integration platforms.

• Exposure to ERP, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, WMS, or Logistics applications.

• Experience with automated API or database testing.

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Agile methodologies.

• Knowledge of JSON, XML, and file-based integrations.

• Balance innovation with platform stability and reliability, in a mission critical environment

• Identify opportunities to improve core workflows, customer value, and new product offerings

• Evaluate opportunities using customer insights, data, and market analysis
Annual Tax Season Delivery

Customer Experience and Execution

title: Hardware Test & Integration Engineer
description:
About Us:

Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network-combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like.

We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators. If you want your code to run on vessels crossing every ocean on earth, this is the place.

Job Description: We're hiring Hardware Test & Integration Engineers to keep our test infrastructure running and growing as fast as our sensor roadmap does. You'll help maintain and expand our hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) test bench at our Virginia HQ, integrating hardware, configuring software, and writing the occasional automated test script (this is a hands-on integration role, not a software development role).

You'll use that infrastructure to evaluate new sensor types and produce clear test results that inform product decisions. You'll take the same rigor out into the field, testing hardware on vessels predominantly in the DC/MD/VA area but at other US sites as needed. Throughout, you'll work cross-functionally with engineering to keep test data and test work secure, efficient, and productive.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design, build, operate, and maintain test infrastructure at our DC-area office and future remote/vessel deployment sites

- Develop, refine, and execute manual and automated test procedures to evaluate current and candidate pieces of hardware

- Work cross-functionally across engineering and product teams at Quartermaster to prioritize and accelerate the evaluation of new sensor models and modalities to accelerate and inform the engineering organization’s development road

- Use and contribute to shared physical and digital test infrastructure across multiple sites and disciplines - coordinating scheduling, logistics, and configuration with the teams that depend on them

- Keep test data, equipment, and procedures organized, secure, and well-documented so results are trustworthy, traceable, and reusable across teams

- Execute field validation testing aboard vessels in the broader DC area and at other US sites as needed, adapting bench procedures to real-world maritime deployment conditions

QUALIFICATIONS (REQUIRED):

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Systems Engineering, Robotics/Mechatronics, Test Engineering, or a related hands-on technical field - or equivalent experience

- Hardware and testing expertise: 4-12 years of experience building and maintaining test benches, including proficiency with hand/power tools, 3D printing, integration of mixed custom and COTS hardware, and execution of manual/automated testing procedures.

- Demonstrated experience building or maintaining test benches or infrastructure - integrating COTS instrumentation, computers, sensors, and ensuring network access for remote engineers.

- Cross-team collaboration: A proven ability to work effectively across multi-disciplinary engineering and product teams while maintaining strong documentation and traceability habits.

- Operational initiative: Desire to conduct field testing in maritime environments and travel as needed to meet project goals. Ability to independently drive projects forward through ambiguity, resource limitations, and tight deadlines.

- US citizenship and valid driver's license required; current security clearance or ability to obtain one is preferred.

title: Principal Product Manager, Discovery & Growth
description:
Find the right problem. Test the right theory. Build the right thing.

Spinwheel is on a mission to reinvent how consumers manage debt, make lending work for them, and move faster than anyone thinks possible. Our platform helps people save time, money, and stress by delivering the tools and intelligence needed to improve financial outcomes. We're hiring a Principal Product Manager, Discovery & Growth , to independently define and drive the discovery motion for Spinwheel 's future product roadmap. This is a Principal level individual contributor role for someone who has already run this kind of function, not someone learning to. You'll set the strategy for how we find, validate, and prove out net-new product and revenue opportunities before they compete for core roadmap investment, and you'll operate with minimal oversight in doing it. This role exists so that new bets get tested with rigor without derailing the core product organization, and so that nothing moves to full build without a proven connection to revenue. You'll report directly to the Head of Product and be trusted to run the full discovery-to-launch pipeline as its owner, not its executor.
What You'll Do

• Set the strategy and process for how Spinwheel finds unmet needs and whitespace in debt, lending, and consumer finance, spending real time with customers, prospects, internal teams, and market data to do it

• Independently shape raw opportunities into testable hypotheses and design the lean experiments (prototypes, concierge MVPs, pilots) that validate or kill them fast, without needing a playbook handed to you

• Build and present the business case for validated opportunities, including the revenue hypothesis and evidence, and drive joint go/no-go decisions with Product and Sales leadership

• Own full 0-to-1 execution end to end for anything that clears the gate, from launch through growth, making the calls on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs yourself

• Instrument products from day one and define what good measurement looks like for a bet at this stage of maturity

• Track post-launch performance against your original revenue hypothesis and turn every bet, proven or not, into an institutional lesson the broader product org can use

• Own and evolve a standing log of active opportunity hypotheses and their stage, visible to Product and Revenue leadership, as a management tool you use to run the function

• Act as the senior voice on industry trends, regulatory shifts, and adjacent market dynamics that could open new doors, and shape how Spinwheel thinks about them

What Success Looks Like

• You surface 2-3 high-conviction opportunities per quarter that the team didn't have on their radar, and your judgment on what's worth testing is trusted without much second-guessing

• You kill bad ideas fast and early, and your track record on when to kill versus back an idea becomes a reference point for the broader org

• You launch multiple net-new revenue-driving products or capabilities from 0-to-1 in your first year, run largely on your own judgment

• You become the senior connective tissue between customer reality and product strategy, shaping how leadership thinks about where to place bets

• Revenue and retention metrics improve because the problems you chose to solve mattered, and other teams start pointing to your process as the model for derisking new ideas

You're a Fit If You

• Have 8+ years in product management with a track record of owning outcomes at a senior or director level, including at least 3 years in fintech (debt, payments, credit, or lending a strong plus) building B2B products for enterprise customers .

• Have led 0-to-1 builds multiple times, ideally including at least one where you built and owned the discovery process itself, not just the execution

• Have deep, demonstrated rigor in testing unproven ideas and know when to kill an idea as confidently as when to back one, with real bets to point to on both sides

title: Director, Compensation
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart , we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu
We're hiring a Director of Compensation to own our broad-based comp strategy end-to-end. This is a senior people leadership role reporting to the Head of Total Rewards. You’ll drive the programs, frameworks, and cross-functional partnerships that keep our pay competitive and fair as we grow into new markets. This role sits at the intersection of people strategy and business partnership, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to how we attract, retain, and motivate the talent that powers Instacart 's growth.
What you'll cook up in your first year
Our annual and mid-year comp cycles run with greater precision and speed. You own the design and delivery end-to-end and have raised the quality bar even as scope and complexity have grown.
Work closely with HR Business Partners, Finance, Legal, and senior business leaders to solve hard problems and give them recommendations they can act on. You'll weigh in on executive offers, retention decisions, org changes, pay equity question, and stand behind difficult calls in gray areas.
Instacart 's equity compensation approach is competitive and forward-looking. You deeply understand the market landscape and drive meaningful changes to how we design and communicate equity.
You lead a high-performing team of compensation business partners. You set clear direction, high standards, and cultivate an environment where people do their best work.
You carry individual contributor responsibilities as a compensation business partner to help you stay close to evolving business needs. Scale your experience to coach your team.
Lead our international expansion compensation work. Build the frameworks, market data, and guidance needed to pay people competitively and compliantly as we expand into new countries.
The secret ingredients we're looking for
Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

• 10+ years of progressive compensation experience, with at least 3 years leading a people management role.

• Proven track record directly supporting large R&D or Engineering functions, with experience advising VP/SVP-level leaders on complex compensation decisions and earning their trust.

• Deep expertise in equity compensation design and strategy. You've worked at a tech company where equity is central to the comp philosophy, and you know how to shape it, not just administer it.

• Experience building compensation programs at scale, not just operating within inherited ones: job architecture, market pricing, performance cycles, and pay-for-performance frameworks.

• You can transform disparate data into a clear recommendation for executives. Expertise in spreadsheet work (gSheets and Excel).

• A genuine interest in how AI and technology can make compensation work better, and the initiative to actually go build it.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualif

title: Medical Coding Specialist - Wound Care
description:

MedHQ, LLC, is a fast growing, leading provider of consulting and technology enabled expert services for outpatient healthcare. With a 97% long-term, client retention rate spanning over 20 years, MedHQ serves Ambulatory Surgery Centers (ASCs), Surgical Hospitals, Physician Practices, and Hospital and Healthcare Outpatient Facilities nationwide. MedHQ, LLC, is a 2022 Becker’s Top 150 Places to Work in Healthcare company.

Position Summary
The Office-Based Wound Care Coder is responsible for reviewing and accurately assigning ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS codes for wound care procedures and office services.. This position ensures compliance with all federal, state, and payer regulations while maximizing appropriate reimbursement. The coder works closely with physicians, clinical staff, and billing teams to clarify documentation, resolve coding issues, and support the overall revenue cycle.
Key Responsibilities

• Review provider documentation from office visits, surgeries, and other wound care services.

• Assign appropriate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes and CPT/HCPCS procedure codes according to official coding guidelines and payer rules.

• Verify coding accuracy and completeness to support correct claim submission and reduce denials.

• Query providers when documentation is incomplete, unclear, or inconsistent with coding guidelines.

• Keep current with wound care coding updates, payer policy changes, and compliance regulations.

• Collaborate with the billing team to resolve claim rejections, denials, and coding-related issues.

• Maintain confidentiality of patient information in compliance with HIPAA regulations.

• Participate in coding audits and provide feedback to improve documentation and coding accuracy.

• Assist in educating providers and staff on documentation improvement related to orthopedic coding.

Qualifications

•
Required:

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Certification as a Certified Professional Coder (CPC) , or equivalent from AAPC/AHIMA.

• Minimum of 2 years of coding experience, preferably in wound care or a related specialty.

•
Preferred:

• Knowledge of office-based E/M and wound care procedures.

• Familiarity with payer-specific wound care coding guidelines.

• Experience with EHR and coding software systems.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, and HCPCS coding guidelines.

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

• Strong communication skills for interacting with providers and team members.

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

• Knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, and physiology (orthopedic focus preferred).

Work Environment

• Mostly sedentary position with extended computer use.

FULL TIME BENEFITS

title: Senior GTM Data Operations Manager
description:
At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests - four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.

In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.

Algolia is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive  GTM Data Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team to ensure our customer and prospect data is trusted, governed, and operationally sound across the entire GTM ecosystem. 

The GTM Data Operations Manager owns the operational health, governance, and integrity of customer and prospect data across the company's go-to-market systems. The role is responsible for ensuring Leads, Contacts, Accounts, and related GTM data are accurate, enriched, synchronized, and governed to enable effective execution across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Analytics.

The role partners closely with GTM Systems, Marketing/Sales Operations, Analytics, Customer Success Operations, and Data / Systems Engineering to maintain reliable data foundations, support automation and AI native workflows, and continuously improve data quality across the revenue technology stack..

About You

You're passionate about building high-quality data foundations that enable great business decisions, and you enjoy solving complex operational problems across systems and teams. You're organized, analytical, and detail-oriented, comfortable owning your area independently while collaborating across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Data / Systems Engineering, and Revenue Operations. You take pride in creating operational excellence behind the scenes, building reliable processes, documenting standards, and continuously improving the quality and integrity of GTM data. Above all, you understand that trusted data is the foundation for exceptional customer experiences, operational efficiency, analytics, AI, and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Data Stewardship, Governance & Quality

• Act as the operational steward for customer and prospect data (Leads, Contacts, and Accounts) across the GTM ecosystem, ensuring data is accurate, complete, consistent, and trusted.

• Own operational governance for customer and prospect data across Salesforce, Marketo, Demandbase and related integrated GTM systems, including data quality standards, telemetry requirements, validation rules, field governance, and operational policies.

• Execute recurring hygiene programs including deduplication, standardization, enrichment validation, and lifecycle management; partner with system owners to resolve data integrity issues.

• Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate requests for new fields, objects, and data standards while maintaining integrity and consistency across the ecosystem.

• Identify data quality risks, drive remediation efforts, and support the evolution of GTM data models as business needs change.

• Data Enrichment & Identity Management:  

• Administer enrichment workflows across GTM platforms.

Why Confluence ?

At Confluence , we’ve always been driven by a commitment to innovation, precision, and partnership in the investment data space. And it stands to reason that none of this would have been possible without the hundreds of hard-working employees who work at Confluence .

More about the role & team

The Data Team is building the next-generation data platform - a multi-tenant platform that will become the shared data layer behind our applications. At the heart of that platform is a Python data API built on a layered router → service → repository architecture, containerized with Docker and deployed entirely through infrastructure-as-code. Today the platform is SQL Server-heavy, and part of this role is migrating business and data logic out of legacy stored procedures into testable Python - parameterized SQL for retrieval, pandas for computation and reshaping. As we evolve, we intend to grow well beyond a single database - incorporating additional and modern data sources (for example, Snowflake, which the API's SQLAlchemy-based connection registry is already designed to add) and the patterns needed to serve them through a unified API. This is a foundational, shaping role: you will help define the architecture and direction of that next-generation platform, not just maintain what exists. We are seeking a Software Engineer with a strong data-engineering focus to join the Data Team. The role is primarily focused on the data API, but it is a team role rather than a single-service one - you will work across the data platform as it grows. This is backend- and data-centric work: you will spend more time on data correctness, performance, and the movement and reconciliation of large datasets across heterogeneous sources than on any single framework or UI library. We value depth in the core technologies and engineering fundamentals over expertise in any specific component, and we expect enough Azure and DevOps capability to deploy and operate what you build.

What skills and experience do I need to succeed?

Exposure to modern cloud data platforms and warehouses (e.g. Snowflake) and an interest in integrating multiple, heterogeneous data sources - each just another SQLAlchemy dialect - behind a unified API.

title: Human Neuroscientist
description:
About Arbor Neuroscience 
(formerly Forest Neurotech)
Arbor is a nonprofit research organization working on one of the hardest open problems in clinical neuroscience: how to change brain circuits by design.
Millions of people with depression, chronic pain, and other brain disorders have no treatment that works. Modulating activity in the brain circuits underlying their symptoms - with electrical stimulation, focused ultrasound, or magnetic stimulation - can work spectacularly well. But it doesn't work reliably, and we can't predict who it will help.
That's what Arbor aims to fix. The starting point is a new class of experiment: intervene, measure how the circuit responds, track the symptom, and repeat in the same individual over months. We’re building the necessary experimental platform. It currently includes the Forest 1 ultrasound system, which works like a wearable functional MRI, but with higher resolution. The system images activity across large brain volumes, including deep brain structures, and will soon stimulate as well. We are also adding electrode-based interfaces in animal studies. From these data, we'll build models to make neuromodulation predictable.
Arbor is a Focused Research Organization within the Convergent Research family, and the new name for Forest Neurotech. We're a mission-focused nonprofit, doing multidisciplinary translational work that doesn't fit in a lab or on a company roadmap. We have the funding to run the first phase, and we're a small team - the people we hire now will shape what Arbor becomes.

title: Dedicated Driver Operations Coordinator
description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.  

Airspace has been rated one of  America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of  CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m. 

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics. 

 

What is the "Dedicated Driver" service?

Airspace partners with leading U.S. Medical Device companies to ensure life-saving equipment is transported safely and securely to hospitals in the local region. If a loved one suffers a serious injury, our Dedicated Drivers are the critical link between warehouses and hospitals, delivering essential surgical tools in real time. Their mission is clear: to equip surgeons with the critical tools for life-saving procedures-because every second counts when a patient is on the table.

The Operations Coordinator is the administrative and documentation backbone for the DD Operational Support Team, primarily supporting the Manager of Operational Support, with additional support for Talent Acquisition Specialists and Regional Managers as capacity allows. This role keeps recruiting, onboarding, and training running on schedule by owning scheduling logistics, candidate and training records, and documentation upkeep. It also supports Regional Managers with performance administration, including metrics tracking, coaching documentation, and PIP paperwork. Reporting to the Manager, DD Operational Support, this role sits alongside recruiting and support functions within the DD Operational Support Team.

This is a detail-oriented, process-driven role best suited for someone who is organized, discreet with sensitive information, and comfortable managing recurring documentation and scheduling cycles across multiple stakeholders at once.

As the Dedicated Driver program continues to grow, this role is expected to grow with it. The responsibilities outlined here represent the current scope, and the right candidate should be comfortable taking on new tasks and workflows as the team's needs develop over time.

title: Commercial Counsel, Deal Desk
description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Commercial Counsel

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Commercial Counsel based in San Francisco to
join the global Deal Desk within the Commercial Legal team at Adyen. As Commercial Counsel,
you will be responsible for negotiating customer-facing contract negotiations, primarily
focused on platform and franchise customers. You will also be responsible for drafting
comprehensive negotiation playbooks, training our commercial colleagues on how to sell our
agreements, advising on contract interpretation, early-stage customer disputes, and other
general commercial matters.
This is a role for a counsel who thrives in a fast-moving, complex environment, who is
commercially-minded, and who can leverage their sophisticated legal expertise and strong
communication skills into tangible, scalable value that accelerates Adyen’s global growth.

What you will do:

● Provide strategic legal advice across various commercial functions, advising
stakeholders in our sales, account management, product, and regulatory teams
globally.
● Draft, review, and negotiate a wide variety of complex, multi-jurisdictional commercial
agreements for our payment, data and financial services products.
● Proactively problem solve for emerging legal and operational risks, providing risk-
based decisions on complex legal issues and proposing improvements and efficiencies
to mitigate future exposure.
● Advise on early-stage customer disputes, managing initial phases of legal conflicts,
and providing counsel on complex legal interpretations.
● Drive legal automation efforts to help scale our team and bring greater efficiency to
the contracting process.
● Work autonomously in a cross-functional manner.
● Build strong relationships with colleagues, leaders, and stakeholders across the
company.
● Participate in training our commercial colleagues across the globe.

Who you are:

● You have 5+ years of legal experience, in house or at a law firm.
● You have strong commercial contracting and/or other transactional experience.
● You can collaborate with other legal counsels based in jurisdictions across the US,
LATAM, EMEA, and APAC.
● You are a team player who likes to collaborate and include different people to sharpen
your ideas.
● You have solid people skills and will work well with a variety of internal and external
stakeholders and customers from varying disciplines and cultures.
● You can work autonomously and run things like your own business.
● You are curious, ask questions, and take ownership over your learning and professional
growth.
● You are self-motivated, driven, reliable, adaptable and detail-oriented.
● You have experience educating others on complex ideas, communicating them clearly,
and providing additional training when necessary.
● You have the ability to structure and prioritize your work in a high volume, fast-paced
environment and build and drive processes to completion.
● You are available to work from our San Francisco office and travel to other offices
periodically.
● You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. Any additional language is a plus
